Duration: 15 seconds | Aspect ratio: 16:9 | Style: High-end beauty commercial

SCENE
Young Asian woman, long wavy brown hair, cream silk tie-neck blouse, gold hoop earrings, delicate gold pendant necklace. Upscale bathroom interior featuring gray-veined marble countertops, dual oval mirrors with thin gold frames, brushed gold fixtures, and subtle greenery.

SHOT BREAKDOWN
0-4s — Medium shot of the woman smiling warmly at the camera, holding a closed black and gold mascara tube. She looks down to twist the cap open.
4-8s — Framed closer, she lifts the wand, examining it while looking off-camera. She raises it to her eye and begins applying mascara to her right upper eyelashes.
8-12s — Extreme close-up isolating her eye and the wand coating her lashes. Cuts to her smiling softly at her reflection in the mirror, wand in hand.
12-15s — Macro product shot. The black and gold tube stands vertically on the marble counter, displaying gold text "IINIIOVIMI". Flanked by blooming white roses and blurred skincare jars.

CAMERA
Locked-off tripod shots with smooth, deliberate cuts. Pronounced shallow depth of field in all close-ups and the final product shot. High definition macro focus used for facial details.

LIGHTING & PALETTE
Soft, diffused natural daylight illuminating the subject evenly. Bright, airy atmosphere. Color palette highlights cream, brushed gold, deep black, pristine white, and warm peach skin tones.

AUDIO
Uplifting, serene instrumental background music. Crisp foley sounds of twisting the plastic cap, faint brushing, and the final placement of the product on marble. No dialogue.

AVOID
Handheld camera shake, harsh shadows, cluttered backgrounds, unnatural eye tracking, dull skin tones.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide shot frames a narrow city side street at night under a steady downpour; wet asphalt mirrors the warm glow of two sodium street lamps and a row of closed storefront windows, rain streaking through the light. A man in his early thirties with damp dark hair under a black raincoat walks in from the left side of the frame, and a woman in her late twenties in a beige wool coat stands under the right street lamp with a closed black umbrella resting in her hand. The camera holds a static shot as the two walk toward each other and stop in the middle of the frame, close enough to look at each other through the falling rain. [Shot 2] At 00:06.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up two-shot at eye level, the man's rain-darkened coat shoulder filling the left of the frame and the woman's wet hair framing her face on the right; she raises her free hand to the lapel of his coat, he tilts his head down, and they kiss gently while droplets run down their cheeks. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as the kiss deepens, rain falling steadily between them. [Shot 3] At 00:10.500, the shot cuts to a long shot from behind the woman; the man releases the kiss, turns, and walks away down the empty street with his back to the camera, his dark raincoat receding along the wet pavement. The camera holds a static shot as his figure shrinks into the mist and the steady rain until he disappears into the darkness at the far end of the street, leaving the woman standing still in the foreground with rain on her face and the closed umbrella in her hand.

overall_soundscape: A steady downpour taps continuously on the wet asphalt, on the woman's coat, and on the closed umbrella. Soft splashes of footsteps cross shallow puddles and fade as the two approach each other, then the man's receding footsteps grow fainter down the empty street. Fabric rustles quietly when the woman touches his lapel, and a single slow exhale is audible just before the kiss.

non_diegetic_music: Sparse solo piano notes at a slow tempo with widely spaced intervals, joined by one sustained low cello line that swells slightly during the kiss and gradually fades to silence as the man walks away.
